name: SynTransitionResource_CallResourceBarrier
description: call [rax+0D0h] = ID3D12GraphicsCommandList::ResourceBarrier(1, TRANSITION, all subresources, flags 0); the most frequent barrier site (45 callers incl. 115B9C texture bind and GfxDevicePresent back buffer -> PRESENT); deferred + batched by gpuopt (Barriers=1)

name: SynFlushGfxStateForDraw_RtBarrier
description: per bound render target, ResourceBarrier(1, RT state 4) inside the RT loop (one call per RT; 4 back-to-back EOP-wait barriers for a 4-target pass in RGP r5); batched by gpuopt

name: SynFlushGfxStateForDraw_DsvBarrier
description: depth buffer ResourceBarrier(1, DEPTH_WRITE 0x10 / DEPTH_READ|SRV) before OMSetRenderTargets (RT-dirty path, c+0xB24 & 1); batched by gpuopt

name: SynFlushGfxStateForDraw_DsvBarrier2
description: depth buffer ResourceBarrier(1) on the depth-state-only path (c+0xB24 & 0x10002, no RT change); batched by gpuopt

name: SynTokUavBarrier_CallResourceBarrier
description: tok 0x8A UAV barrier (resource from the stream, may be NULL); RGP r5 shows NO barrier between the 74/75 single-group particle dispatches, so these are not per-emitter barriers there

name: SynSetIndexBufferTracked
description: tok 0x7A/0x7B (callers 45AF68, 45AB1C, 114878): if the index buffer changed: state-tracked transition (state & 0xAC3 | ib+0x50, reset to COMMON when the per-list stamp c+0x6D0 differs) then IASetIndexBuffer (vtbl+0x158)

name: SynSetIndexBufferTracked_Barrier
description: ResourceBarrier(1, TRANSITION) of the index buffer

name: SynTokSetIndexBuffer
description: tok 0x3D: same as SynSetIndexBufferTracked with the view pointer read from the stream (aka RenderSubmitHot_114A20)

name: SynTokSetIndexBuffer_Barrier
description: ResourceBarrier(1, TRANSITION) of the index buffer

name: SynTokTransitionResource
description: tok 0x9B: explicit state-tracked transition from the stream (resource, state slot, new state, stamp, subresource); skips equal states

name: SynCopyTextureRegionTracked
signature: void (SynCtx* c, ID3D12Resource* dst, u32* dstState, u32 dstSub, u32 x, u32 y, u32 z, ID3D12Resource* src, u32* srcState, u32 srcSub, D3D12_BOX* box)
description: tok 0x92 (via 7F9A6C): src -> COPY_SOURCE and dst -> COPY_DEST as two separate ResourceBarrier calls, CopyTextureRegion (vtbl+0x80), then both restored to their previous states as two more calls (2+2 -> 1+1 with gpuopt; the restore is a split-barrier candidate)

name: SynCopyTextureRegionTracked_SrcRestore
description: ResourceBarrier(1): src back to its previous state after the copy

name: SynCopyTextureRegionTracked_DstRestore
description: ResourceBarrier(1): dst back to its previous state after the copy
